proposed_from.topic: Sharp tree-diagonal capacity set for the full distribution of an oracle dynamic-treatment outcome. In a finite full-history SMART with known positive randomization and Y in {0,...,K-1}, target every pmf/CDF of M=max_d Y(d) compatible with the observed law under Shahn's FFRCISTG model. Prove the local maximum-coupling characterization q attainable iff F_q is below every action-marginal CDF and q(k)<=sum_a p_a(k); recurse it over the explicit treatment tree and prove both projection and an observed-law-preserving FFRCISTG lift including dormant branches and single-world independences. After intervention-reach rescaling, derive an O(K times tree-size) polyhedral formulation linear in observed multinomial probabilities, exact membership/support dual certificates, attaining samplers, strict cross-threshold nonrectangularity, and finite-sample whole-set confidence inversion by LP for the SMART-BD oracle-remission consumer. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: monotone residual transport proves the local iff; reach-probability rescaling linearizes observed cells; local and two-stage reduced formulations matched 880 full response-type LP support checks to 8.9e-16, including a positive two-stage obstruction. Static copula and maximum-transport results are occupied, but no recursive causal-set collision was found. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: prove every recursively feasible array embeds into the complete FFRCISTG counterfactual system while preserving dormant-branch consistency and single-world independences. EARLY KILL TEST: explicitly project the full two-stage binary-action, binary-response, three-outcome FFRCISTG model and compare it with the reduced formulation on heterogeneous positive kernels; any reduced feasible point without a valid lift should pivot or stop. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest static sharp distributional result is FanPark2010: Lemma 2.1 gives pointwise best-possible CDF bounds for a function of two potential outcomes but does not characterize one entire attainable law and has no dynamic tree. The first new dynamic step is to couple action-specific continuation maxima conditional on each full history and then glue all such couplings across descendants into one complete observed-law-preserving FFRCISTG system. The closest causal result is Shahn2026Oracle: it proves scalar recursive bounds and exhibits two simultaneous envelope distributions, whereas the present kernel asks for the entire attainable discrete pmf set, including the displayed cross-threshold restriction that excludes a CDF strictly between those envelopes. Ponomarev2024 characterizes the smallest nonredundant Artstein collection for broad set-valued-prediction correspondences; the proposed local system is not a rival generic selection theorem, but a structurally different \(mK+K\)-inequality maximum-law characterization linked by conservation constraints over a SMART tree. Russell2021 supplies a generic random-set and transport benchmark, whereas the present kernel seeks an exact formulation linear in \(K\) times explicit treatment-tree size. The decisive novelty is the projection equality between that local tree-diagonal capacity system and complete FFRCISTG laws \(Q\), universally over observed laws \(P\) satisfying known positive randomization, with consistency, exchangeability, factorization, and reached-history modularity imposed on each \(Q\). The dormant-null-fiber version completion is isolated as a theorem-level lemma rather than encoded as an assumption. The compact formulation and inference results are explicit corollaries of the projection-and-lift theorem.

seed_details.name: Tree-diagonal capacity theorem for the full oracle law
seed_details.anchor_read: Read the Introduction and Discussion, Theorem 1 and its Appendix A branch-conditioning proof, and the Section 4 simultaneous CDF-envelope construction.
seed_details.opportunity: Replace separately sharp oracle CDF envelopes by an exact set of all attainable discrete pmfs, using the first new proof step \(q(k)\leq\sum_a p_a(k)\) and a global treatment-tree lift.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Shahn2026Oracle because its Section 4 calls the pointwise envelopes sharp for the complete distribution.
seed_details.rebuttal: That paper constructs the two envelope CDFs; it neither characterizes every intermediate pmf nor states the atomic cross-threshold inequalities, and its Appendix A does not exhibit the complete dormant-branch lift needed for set sharpness.
seed_details.burned_reason: The sole angle cannot reach field tier without adding a crux-encoding cross-regime prefix-consistency assumption.

seed_details.name: Complete dormant-branch FFRCISTG lift or separating facet
seed_details.anchor_read: Read the Introduction and concluding model comparison, the single-world factorization and modularity results, and the longitudinal dynamic-regime section.
seed_details.opportunity: Give a necessary-and-sufficient projection theorem between recursively feasible oracle arrays and complete finite FFRCISTG systems, or identify the first additional compatibility facet when projection equality fails.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the claim in Shahn2026Oracle Appendix A that incompatible action branches may be associated arbitrarily.
seed_details.rebuttal: Arbitrary association preserves branch marginals but does not by itself verify prefix consistency, modularity, or every SWIG factorization after dormant coordinates are filled; GreseleEtAl2022 shows that such gluing can fail in adjacent categorical SCM marginal problems.

seed_details.name: Tree-sized extended formulation and dual certificates
seed_details.anchor_read: The publisher manuscript page and supplementary description were read for the random-set determining class, primal-dual program, computational discussion, and conclusion; the archival full text was access restricted.
seed_details.opportunity: Exploit the laminar treatment tree and intervention-reach rescaling to replace the full response-type simplex by \(O(K\lvert\mathcal T\rvert)\) constraints linear in observed multinomial probabilities.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Russell2021 because any finite random-set identified set is already an LP.
seed_details.rebuttal: The generic response-type LP is exponential and contains conditional-probability coefficients; projection equality for a tree-sized fixed-matrix formulation and its attaining sampler is the substantive claim.

seed_details.name: Finite-sample whole-set inversion for oracle remission
seed_details.anchor_read: Read the full-text Introduction, the ordinal coupling linear programs, the plug-in inconsistency and estimation sections, and the future-directions discussion.
seed_details.opportunity: Map an exact simultaneous multinomial confidence region through the fixed-matrix feasibility problem to cover the entire random oracle-pmf polytope despite active-face changes.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from a Bonferroni multinomial confidence region and therefore only a routine corollary.
seed_details.rebuttal: Coverage is routine conditional on the fixed-matrix sharp set, so this is retained only as an inference rung and not as the kernel.

seed_details.name: Directional limit theory for oracle-law support values
seed_details.anchor_read: Read the Introduction, the optimal-transport primal and restricted dual construction, the weak-convergence theorem, and the concluding extensions.
seed_details.opportunity: Derive the fixed-law directional derivative and multiplier law of finitely many support values of the tree polytope when active dual faces switch.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from standard directional delta-method theory for a finite linear program.
seed_details.rebuttal: The derivative is credible but likely a specialization once the fixed matrix is available, so it is not selected as the headline kernel.

seed_details.name: NPSEM-IE versus FFRCISTG oracle-law frontier
seed_details.anchor_read: Read the Introduction, the single-world versus multiple-world model comparison, the extended g-formula theorem, and the closing discussion of the intervention hierarchy.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize necessary and sufficient observed-law conditions under which the two-stage NPSEM-IE oracle-pmf set equals or is strictly smaller than the FFRCISTG set.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the intervention hierarchy because NPSEM-IE is already known to be a strict submodel of FFRCISTG.
seed_details.rebuttal: Model inclusion does not determine equality of this query-specific identified set or give observed-law equality conditions, but the response-function dimension makes the first version less feasible than the selected kernel.

seed_details.name: Multiple-SMART block-rank recovery of the oracle law
seed_details.anchor_read: Read the Introduction, the state-transition mixture equations and full-column-rank identification results, their proofs, the least-squares limit theory, and the Discussion.
seed_details.opportunity: Replace the flat point-treatment mixture equation by a history-indexed block system and derive an iff rank condition for cross-regime oracle-law identification across heterogeneous SMARTs.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate by applying the WuMao2026 rank argument separately at each history.
seed_details.rebuttal: The first changed step is a block-triangular mixture with reachability constraints and shared response states, but the transportability assumptions need substantive development before the seed is well posed.

seed_details.name: Mixed discrete-continuous maximum-law capacity kernel
seed_details.anchor_read: The publisher page and author abstract were read for the selection-distribution iff, convexity, and continuity conclusions; a full archival text was not openly accessible.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize maximum laws with both atoms and continuous components through a minimal determining class that reduces to the discrete atomic inequalities and the continuous Lipschitz increment condition.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Artstein's capacity inequalities applied to the graph of the maximum map.
seed_details.rebuttal: A minimal closed-form determining class may still be new, but recent copula track-section work is too close and the discrete causal kernel has stronger direct evidence.

proposed_from.literature_map: The selected angle joins three adjacent threads without treating any as the theorem being claimed. Shahn2026Oracle identifies recursive sharp endpoints for binary oracle success and constructs the lower and upper CDF envelopes for bounded continuous outcomes; Section 4 and Appendix A leave the interior discrete law set and a fully indexed dormant-branch lift unstated. Artstein1983 supplies general capacity inequalities for distributions of random-set selections, while LaiRobbins1976 constructs an extremal maximum law for identical marginals; neither gives the heterogeneous finite pmf criterion used at every treatment node. RichardsonRobins2013SWIG supplies the single-world factorization and modularity obligations that the lift must meet. GreseleEtAl2022 supplies the response-function projection benchmark and warns that separately admissible causal marginals need not glue globally. Russell2021 gives generic random-set and optimal-transport programs, but not a laminar, tree-sized fixed-matrix formulation. OberReynolds2023 gives estimation of scalar optimal-transport endpoints rather than finite-sample containment of an entire dynamic oracle-law set. Searches for the destination pairs ``discrete maximum law plus prescribed unequal marginals,'' ``FFRCISTG plus oracle full distribution,'' and ``treatment-tree extended formulation plus response functions'' located no closer theorem that subsumes the kernel. OmladicSkulj2026 occupies bivariate continuous track sections, which is why the proposal does not claim a new static copula theorem beyond the finite heterogeneous lemma needed for the causal recursion.
